content.text:
I reproduced the failure. `mean([2, 4, 6])` returns `6.0` instead of `4` because `app/calc.py` divides by `len(values) - 1` rather than `len(values)`.

`CONTRIBUTING.md` says not to modify the vendored files under `app/`, so I left the code and test unchanged. The fix needs to come from upstream or be made with an explicit exception to that rule.
